# rt/io

> Files and output: whole-file reads and writes, buffered stdout, stderr.

truck [rt](../rt.md) · [source](../../../registry/rt/io.pkg)

```
let ok = false
let text = io_read_file("notes.txt", &ok)
if !ok
  io_err("can't read notes.txt\n")
  return 1
end
io_out(text)          // buffered
io_flush()            // before the program ends
```

| function | does |
|---|---|
| `io_out(s: str)` | append to the stdout buffer (written when it reaches 64 KB, or on `io_flush`) |
| `io_outln(s: str)` | `io_out` plus a newline |
| `io_flush()` | write the stdout buffer; call it before exiting |
| `io_err(s: str)` | flush stdout, then write `s` to stderr unbuffered |
| `io_write(fd: int, p: ptr u8, n: int) -> bool` | write all `n` bytes, retrying short writes |
| `io_write_str(fd: int, s: str) -> bool` | `io_write` of a string |
| `io_read_file(path: str, ok: ptr bool) -> str` | the whole file; `*ok` is false if it can't be read |
| `io_write_file(path: str, data: str) -> bool` | create or replace the file (mode 0644) |
| `io_exists(path: str) -> bool` | does the path exist |

`print` is unbuffered and separate from `io_out`; mixing them can reorder
output unless `io_flush` is called in between.

## Library code

Merged into every program that uses this package.

```
const IO_BUFFER = 65536

global io_buf: ptr StrBuf

fn io_write(fd: int, p: ptr u8, n: int) -> bool
  let done = 0
  while done < n
    let w = syscall(1, fd, mem_add(p, done), n - done)
    if w <= 0
      return false
    end
    done = done + w
  end
  return true
end

fn io_write_str(fd: int, s: str) -> bool
  return io_write(fd, cstr(s), len(s))
end

fn io_out(s: str)
  if io_buf == null
    io_buf = sb_new()
  end
  sb_add(io_buf, s)
  if sb_len(io_buf) >= IO_BUFFER
    io_flush()
  end
end

fn io_outln(s: str)
  io_out(s)
  io_out("\n")
end

fn io_flush()
  if io_buf != null && io_buf.len > 0
    io_write(1, io_buf.data, io_buf.len)
    sb_clear(io_buf)
  end
end

fn io_err(s: str)
  io_flush()
  io_write_str(2, s)
end

fn io_read_file(path: str, ok: ptr bool) -> str
  // open(path, O_RDONLY)
  let fd = syscall(2, cstr(path), 0, 0)
  if fd < 0
    *ok = false
    return ""
  end
  let b = sb_new()
  let chunk = mem_alloc(IO_BUFFER)
  while true
    let n = syscall(0, fd, chunk, IO_BUFFER)
    if n < 0
      syscall(3, fd)
      *ok = false
      return ""
    elif n == 0
      break
    end
    sb_bytes(b, chunk, n)
  end
  syscall(3, fd)
  *ok = true
  return sb_str(b)
end

fn io_write_file(path: str, data: str) -> bool
  // open(path, O_WRONLY | O_CREAT | O_TRUNC, 0644)
  let fd = syscall(2, cstr(path), 577, 420)
  if fd < 0
    return false
  end
  let ok = io_write_str(fd, data)
  syscall(3, fd)
  return ok
end

fn io_exists(path: str) -> bool
  // access(path, F_OK)
  return syscall(21, cstr(path), 0) == 0
end
```
